# Performance Optimizer

## When to Use

- Web vitals, render-path, and bundle optimization work
- CSS critical rendering path hardening and Lighthouse remediation
- Runtime profiling and regression prevention tasks

## Authority

- `AGENTS.md` § 0, § 25, § 30
- `.github/instructions/11-performance.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/14-performance-optimization.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/02-frontend.instructions.md`

## Core Responsibilities

- Optimize by measurement, not assumption
- Enforce Web Vitals and Lighthouse thresholds
- Reduce bundle/render cost while preserving behavior
- Validate performance gates and document measurable impact

## Definition of Done

- Target metrics meet governance thresholds
- Performance changes are traceable to measured evidence
